standard_prerequisites.name: Monomorphism with a section is an isomorphism
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Descent on Spaces, lemma descending-property-monomorphism plus the elementary section fact (cross-chapter, named)

core_obligations: View u, v as 1-morphisms via 2-Yoneda and form the 2-fibre product (Sch/U) x_{j o v, Y} X; represent it by F_{j o v}, a monomorphism over U.
The section (1_U, v, 1_{j(v)}) identifies F_{j o v} = U, since a monomorphism of algebraic spaces with a section is an isomorphism.
Conclude the first projection of the 2-fibre product is an equivalence of fibre categories.
Lift the given isomorphism t: j(u) -> j(v) through the equivalence to a 2-morphism, i.e. a morphism t-tilde: u -> v with j(t-tilde) = t.
proof_roadmap: 2-Yoneda and the 2-fibre product; monomorphism-with-section identification; equivalence of fibre categories; lift of t.
difficulty_reason: The monomorphism-with-section identification does real work and the lift is a genuine 2-categorical construction.
